title: Trade review 5 Nov: 19 results, 5 lessons
summary: 6 closed at T2 (GMRAIRPORT +8.1%, M&M, SBILIFE, PREMIERENE, HINDALCO, MARUTI), 9 hit T1, SMLMAH failed −18.6%. Win rate 82.7%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Thu 5 Nov:** 6 trades closed at T2, 9 hit T1, SMLMAH failed at 30 days (a retest), 2 missed winners.

Nifty jumped 2.40% to 24,536.60, and the open trades rode it. All 52 closed trades now total +189.4% (average +3.6%), against +168.8% from 43 last night. Running trades below their buy price fell to 23 of 48. Friday's 30-day exits are GNA (−8.7%) and GRANULES (T1 booked, now −4.1%). Monday has nine, including GKSL (−16.4%), QUADFUTURE (−16.4%) and NRBBEARING (−14.7%).

**Today's results**
- ✅✅ **GMRAIRPORT** (listed 14 Oct): bought ₹90.02, sold ₹97.30 after 21 days, **+8.09%**, back from a −6.44% dip.
- ✅✅ **M&M** (listed 22 Oct): bought ₹2,826.63, sold ₹2,996.23 after 13 days, **+6.00%**.
- ✅✅ **SBILIFE** (listed 22 Oct): bought ₹1,631.52, sold ₹1,729.41 after 13 days, **+6.00%**.
- ✅✅ **PREMIERENE** (listed 29 Oct): bought ₹858.87, sold ₹910.40 after 6 days, **+6.00%**, no dip.
- ✅✅ **HINDALCO** (listed 13 Oct): bought ₹889.92, sold ₹943.32 after 22 days, **+6.00%**.
- ✅✅ **MARUTI** (listed 15 Oct): bought ₹11,391.23, sold ₹12,074.71 after 20 days, **+6.00%**.
- ✅ **9 hit T1, still open:** SUNDARMFIN, IDFCFIRSTB, WAAREEENER, BANKINDIA, HDFCLIFE, KOTAKBANK, TMPV, TATAPOWER, ENGINERSIN.
- 🟢 **LUPIN**: dipped in and filled at ₹1,958.03; now +1.53%.
- ➖ **COROMANDEL**: not bought, missed winner (came within 2.7% of the zone).
- ❌ **SMLMAH** (Retest): failed at 30 days, **−18.63%**. Same spike-then-slide shape as YATHARTH and ACMESOLAR; the retest change now keeps these off the list.
- ❌ **LIQUIDPLUS / LIQUIDCASE**: liquid-fund ETFs that can't move +3% in a month; the ETF filter should keep them out.

**Lessons**
- Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list): 31 trades average −4.0% vs +2.6% for the other 69. (holding)
- Pullbacks reach T1 most often and make the most money: 21 of 25 reached T1; none of 15 closed lost money, +87.6%. (holding)
- Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners: 14 of 20 would have reached T1 at the next open. (holding)
- Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) often means no fill, and a bad fill: 7 of 12 filled; fills dip −10.2%. (holding)
- The top-10 cut leaves winners behind: near misses reached T1 72% (81 of 113) vs 66% for real picks, fourth review in a row. (new)

Early signs: candle-at-support picks are now the best group (20 of 39 at T2, 51%, shallowest dip −4.2%). F&O stocks reach T2 nearly twice as often as cash stocks (47% vs 25%) and dip far less (−3.3% vs −11.4%).

**Proposed change:** none tonight. The retest change has been live for only 2 days; the near-miss lesson needs a proposal with numbers first.
